One of the most infuriating general traits of the #technology sector and elite #programming nerds is that they've grown up so used to being *treated*, so used to being showered in money and high-end technical toys which are always getting replaced with newer ones, they've come to think of #computing as somehow a free action, something that's just THERE like it was oxygen in air, and that false assumption of the ubiquity and free access to "compute" (gawd **who coined that** I wanna kick their shins) has informed all the decisions of high-tech leaders for many years now. The #cloud is another manifestation of this dubious faith in computing as a fixed state of existence.

(etc.)
